sameArmorSet.label: Require same armor set
sameArmorSet.help: Only group or compare pieces from the same set. Off: same slot + archetype + tertiary across all sets.

sameTuningStat.label: Require same tuning stat
sameTuningStat.help: Split by tuning stat (e.g. Weapons vs Grenade). Off: mixed tuning stats in one bucket.

respectKeepFavorite.label: Respect DIM keep and favorite when picking junk
respectKeepFavorite.help: When on, keep- and favorite-tagged pieces are not suggested as junk in dupe flows.

excludeJunk.label: Exclude junk-tagged pieces from dupe counts

suggestions.setAwareHeavy: {{totalT5}} Tier 5 pieces and {{heavyBuckets}} buckets with 5+ items. Use same armor set to avoid false dupes.
suggestions.looseSmallVault: Small vault: loose rules will surface more duplicate buckets.
suggestions.ignoreTaggedKeep: {{count}} dupe candidates already tagged keep or favorite in DIM.
suggestions.standardDefault: Standard preset for your vault size.

cardBody.loose: Compare pieces in the same slot without requiring the same armor set or tuning stat.
cardBody.standard: Compare by slot, archetype, and tertiary without requiring the same armor set.
cardBody.setAware: Groups duplicates by armor set · works well for most vaults.
cardBody.tuning: Groups duplicates by tuning stat, even across different armor sets.
cardBody.strict: Requires the same armor set and tuning stat for a duplicate match.

matchStyle.dimTagsRespect: DIM keep and favorite tags count when suggesting junk.
matchStyle.dimTagsIgnore: Keep and favorite tags are not used when suggesting junk.
